Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in document CHEMBL5244275. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
